verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference page and an OpenAPI 3.1 description for code generators, plus a `cafe api` CLI command for sending authenticated requests. None of it documents an interactive, browsable API explorer with runnable or try-it examples. The OpenAPI spec and CLI passthrough are building blocks or adjacent tools, not the capability itself, and probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
